newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes flat after brief US-led rally.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes flat after brief US-led rally.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed flat on Wednesday after testing the upside briefly in the afternoon on the back of a rising NYMEX complex that lost steam shortly afterwards, traders said.
July gas oil ended unchanged at $160.25 a tonne, in the middle of a $2 range.

"Gas oil was pretty lacklustre. There was a little bit of buying on the States opening, short covering in the market and people expected it to be a little bit weaker after the bearish APIs," one trader said.
"It was not weak, the rally was a short covering rally and it moved back to unchanged," the trader said. "Basically, you are looking at a market that is waiting to see what comes out of OPEC."
Meanwhile, IPE August Brent continued to trade near the session lows after briefly testing the upside on the back of the rising NYMEX complex.
August Brent was 13 cents down at $17.74 a barrel by 1642 GMT after reaching as high as $17.99 as NYMEX strengthened.

"(August) NYMEX crude was holding above $19.00 for ages but then it came off," one broker said. "Also there is no fresh news from OPEC. So IPE tested the upside, but lost momentum and came down again."

All 11 OPEC heads of delegation began their meeting in Vienna at 1500 GMT but most brokers said they expected nothing radical from the cartel, as it was expected to rollover its existing production ceiling of 25.03 million barrels per day.
